The trigonal Sr12Cu6Ge6 phase (reduced formula Sr2CuGe) crystallizes in space group R-3m (No. 166), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in an octahedral environment with six neighbors (3 Ge and 3 Sr), while Ge centers have 9 neighbors (3 Cu, 3 Ge, 3 Sr). Corner-sharing between Cu octahedra and edge-sharing between Cu octahedra and Ge 9-vertex polyhedra are observed, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
